title: Implementing Defence’s Strategic Mobilisation Plan through an Enterprise Project Management Office
summary: Providence, A Tetra Tech Company established and operated a specialist project management office (PMO) to coordinate the implementation of Defence’s Strategic Mobilisation Plan across Defence and other government agencies.
body_markdown:
Providence, A Tetra Tech Company established and operated a specialist project management office (PMO) to coordinate the implementation of Defence’s Strategic Mobilisation Plan across Defence and other government agencies.


## Challenge


The newly established Mobilisation Implementation Directorate within Force Exploration Branch was responsible for implementing the Defence Strategic Mobilisation Plan and its key initiatives across a complex enterprise environment. This required extensive coordination across Defence Groups and Services, engagement with other government agencies, and adaptation to evolving strategic guidance.


## Solution


Providence established a specialist PMO comprising program and project management, scheduling, administration and strategic business advisory capability. The team supported the design, development and implementation of the Defence Strategic Mobilisation Plan and coordinated planning and work effort across 407 mobilisation work packages.


Providence established governance frameworks, risk reporting, program controls, performance tracking, and scheduling arrangements. The team also facilitated senior stakeholder workshops and supported Mobilisation Factor Coordinators responsible for progressing the Plan across areas including infrastructure, logistics and fuels, and data and information.


## Benefits


- Coordinated more than 400 mobilisation work packages across Defence
- Established the governance, planning, scheduling and reporting arrangements for implementation
- Improved visibility of progress, risks, dependencies, and performance
- Supported coordination across Defence Groups, Services, and other government agencies
- Provided a scalable specialist PMO aligned with evolving Defence strategic guidance
